title: The World Around Us
summary: People and places, the natural and built environment, weather and climate, communications and technology, shopping, measurements and materials.
subtopics: People and places: continents, countries, nationalities and compass points
The natural world, environment, climate, weather and animals
Communications and technology: the digital world, documents and texts
The built environment: buildings, services, urban areas and shopping
Measurements: size and shape; materials and their properties
grammar: Place expressions, compass directions and locative prepositions
Comparative and superlative forms for places, climate and services
Cause, effect, contrast and solution connectors
Passive voice for processes, environmental change and technology
Relative clauses and participles for description and definition
Numbers, measurements, shapes, materials and agreement

skills.Listening: Weather forecasts, news reports, directions, service information and technology discussions
skills.Reading: Maps, articles, public notices, adverts, webpages, messages and product information
skills.Speaking: Compare places, discuss environmental action, explain technology and manage shopping situations
skills.Writing: Place descriptions, environmental articles, balanced opinions and formal/informal messages

lessons.title: People, Places, Continents and Compass Points
lessons.focus: Locate, identify and compare places accurately.

lessons.title: Landscapes, Nature and Animals
lessons.focus: Describe natural settings and explain relationships within them.

lessons.title: Climate, Seasons and Weather
lessons.focus: Understand forecasts and compare climate across regions and seasons.

lessons.title: Environmental Problems and Their Causes
lessons.focus: Explain pollution, climate change and habitat loss through cause and effect.

lessons.title: Environmental Solutions and Responsibility
lessons.focus: Propose, justify and evaluate practical environmental action.

lessons.title: The Digital World and Communication
lessons.focus: Discuss devices, platforms, benefits, risks and patterns of use.

lessons.title: Documents, Texts and Digital Information
lessons.focus: Interpret messages, forms, webpages and instructions critically.

lessons.title: Buildings, Services and Urban Areas
lessons.focus: Describe a town and evaluate the availability and quality of services.

lessons.title: Shopping, Prices and Consumer Choices
lessons.focus: Understand adverts and transactions, compare products and resolve problems.

lessons.title: Measurements, Shapes and Materials
lessons.focus: Describe size, form, composition, use and suitability precisely.

lessons.title: Topic C Integrated Communication Workshop
lessons.focus: Connect environmental, technological and urban issues across all four skills.
